title: PRISM/A — Configuration
description: Configuration file for a PRISM/A Application Architecture workspace (.prism-a/config.yaml).

organization.description: Name of the organization or product team this workspace belongs to.

description.description: Free-text description of the scope or purpose of this workspace.

domain.description: Primary business domain this workspace covers (e.g. 'Insurance', 'Payments').

scope.description: Breadth of this workspace — enterprise-wide, a single product, or a scoped portion of one.

temporal_state.description: Default temporal state for artifacts in this workspace.

active_dimensions.description: Which PRISM/A dimensions are actively maintained in this workspace.

tech_governance.description: Technical governance settings for this workspace.

schema_registry.description: Whether a schema registry (e.g. Confluent, AWS Glue) is in use for event/data contracts.

adr_required.description: Whether an ADR is required before any significant architectural decision.

api_review_required.description: Whether new APIs must pass a formal API design review before publication.

author.description: Author or owner of this landscape.

contact.description: Contact email or handle for questions about this landscape.

created_date.description: ISO 8601 date when this landscape was first created.

last_modified.description: ISO 8601 date of the last modification.

reviewed_by.description: Name or handle of last reviewer.

review_date.description: ISO 8601 date of last formal review.
